info.name: Process Street Public Attachments Form Fields API
List all form fields in a workflow

params.description:
Opaque pagination cursor. Take this value from the previous response's `links[]` entry whose `name`
is `"next"` (typically just follow that link's `href` instead of reading this value).
Omit on the first page. If the previous response had no `next` link, there are no more pages.

items.docs:
Gets a page of form fields for a workflow.
Form fields are paged, meaning the links section in the
response must be used to get the next/previous batch of form fields.

info.name: List all options for a form field

params.description:
Opaque pagination cursor. Take this value from the previous response's `links[]` entry whose `name`
is `"next"` (typically just follow that link's `href` instead of reading this value).
Omit on the first page. If the previous response had no `next` link, there are no more pages.

items.docs:
Gets a page of form field options.
Options are paged, meaning the links section in the response must be used to get the next/previous batch of form field options. If the field is linked to a Data Set Saved View, then the Row IDs are also listed in the response.
